test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Which number from among the given options can replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

6, 12, ?, 32, 36, 72
solution:
Logic : Alternately (2) is multiplied and (4) is added to each number subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d5dd0d244168c77c37d12833dc96fed113c0b5e129cf73599cf894960341417.png] 

Hence, **"16"** is the correct answer.
